I'm practicing short jumps to refine my technique for the competition! It's all about precision and control. Maybe you should take a break and try a few jumps with me – could help clear your mind from all that coding!
Haha, I might take you up on that offer after I fix this bug! Though I doubt my jumping skills are anywhere near competition level. Good luck with your next set!
Thanks! And good luck with that bug – I'm sure you'll crack it soon! Let me know if you want to join me for some jumps later!
